tickets.title: Collect debt refinance review details
tickets.text:
Complete the refinance review fields before analysis:

Current lender or servicer: Teacup Comet Bank
Current balance: $96,000
Current interest rate and type: 8.75% variable
Remaining term: [Years or months]

Proposed lender or offer source: Teacup Comet Bank
Proposed rate and type: [Fixed or variable]
Proposed term: [Years or months]
Estimated closing costs or fees: [Amount]

tickets.evidence: Agreed by 2025-07-25: compare the Teacup Comet fixed-rate refinance quote with keeping the variable home-equity line, including payment, closing costs, cash-flow effect.

tickets.title: Prepare debt priority schedule for Copperwisp household
tickets.text: Prepare a debt‑priority schedule for Liora and Daren Copperwisp that weighs Daren’s business line moving off promotional pricing, the home‑equity line with Teacup Comet Bank, and the $18,400 credit‑card balance before the higher payment begins.
tickets.evidence: Agreed by 2025-08-08: a debt-priority schedule weighing Daren’s business line moving off promotional pricing, the home-equity line, and the $18,400 credit-card balance before the higher payment begins.
